items.description: The Jetstar plane was taxiing ‌for takeoff to Queensland state’s Gold Coast when its flight crew saw ‌the Qatar Airways plane, which was being ‌towed ⁠by an aircraft tug, very close ⁠on a crossing taxiway, the regulator said

items.title: Palestinians in Gaza remain wary as Israeli strikes ease
items.description: The relentless sound of warplanes, the buzz of drones overhead, and the strikes across the Gaza Strip have subsided over the past few days, leaving Palestinians wary of what could come next.
